title: Comparative evaluation of the aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI) and its modified version for early detection of central line-associated bloodstream infection: a pilot study using machine learning techniques.
summary: Full primary article supports a retrospective, single-center result: 234 central-line patients (39 CLABSI), four ML algorithms, modified AISI/XGBoost AUROC 0.99, 97% sensitivity and 98% specificity. Authors require prospective validation and caution against treatment use.
ai_technology: four models (LR, XGBoost, SVM, AdaBoost) with AISI/modified AISI and clinical variables; 70:30 train/test.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
